search.description.text: Search the SAIPEN documentation, specification, ecosystem and blog.

search.badge-note.text: runs in your browser over a static index — no query leaves this page

search.field.help.text: Tip: Ctrl+K or Cmd+K opens this page from anywhere. Technical pages rank above blog posts.

search.status.nojs.text: Search runs in your browser. With JavaScript off, use the [documentation index](/docs/) or the [specification](/spec/).

search.status.prompt.text: Type a word and press Search.

search.status.many.note: Two or more results. Languages with more plural forms may need a later plural-rule extension; keep {count} and {query}.
